- **Belongs to:** the core ([the journeys](../journeys.md)); it runs with every module on, and the core journeys run again with each module left out
- **Requirements:** `NO-LOST-UPDATES`
- **Budget:** 8 steps, not scored: this journey’s ease test leaves `budget` out, so it may take more (the steps below are counted all the same)
- **Ease test:** every point but `entry`, `budget` ([the ease test](../../core/journeys.md#the-ease-test))

## Steps and checks

- Open a fresh browser as Tariq (`tariq`).
- Go to `/goals/ns-ai/edit` in the demo.
- Go to `/goals/ns-ai/edit` in the demo.
- **Check:** The “Name” field shows.
- **Check:** The “Name” field shows.
- _Note:_ A renames it and saves.
- **Step.** Type “AI-assisted pull request review” into the “Name” field.
- **Step.** Press the “Save changes” button.
- **Check:** “AI-assisted pull request review” is shown.
- _Note:_ B, still looking at the old version, changes the source and saves: refused, and shown the latest.
- Press the words “More details”.
- **Step.** Type “Engineering metrics warehouse” into the “Data source” field.
- **Step.** Press the “Save changes” button.
- **Check:** “Someone else changed this a moment ago” is shown (else: the second save is not told it was refused).
- **Check:** (`errors`) scored as met here.
- **Check:** Checkpoint “refused”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- **Check:** (`finish`) met when `g.title === 'AI-assisted pull request review' && g.source !== 'Engineering metrics warehouse'`, where `const s = await h.snapshot()`; `const g = s.goals.find((x) => x.id === 'ns-ai')`. Else it says: the first save was overwritten or the second landed (title “{g.title}”, source “{g.source}”).
- **Check:** (`logged`) met when `s.changes.filter((c) => c.goalId === 'ns-ai' && c.action === 'edited' && !s0.changes.some((o) => o.id === c.id)).length === 1`, where `const s0 = await h.snapshot()`; `const s = await h.snapshot()`. Else it says: the refused save was logged.
- **Check:** (`attention`) scored as met here.
- **Check:** (`progress`) scored as met here.
- Close this browser.
